# Section loader

Copies section n from flash to its run-time range and then sets its bit in the copied mask.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x60045ed5` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-beta">Corroborated</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om3-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md)

Reads the end through 0x60045e6c, copies end minus start bytes through the flash driver to an uncached alias, and sets bit n-1 at 0xa32de590 whatever the copy returned.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Olympus firmware research](../projects/oly-fw-analysis.md)): Converts the destination to an uncached alias, reads end-start bytes and sets a loaded bit. Source: [Finding space for added code](../sources/fishcu.code-space.md).
- **Static analysis** ([OM-Emu](../projects/om-emu.md)): Disassembled; it logs a non-zero copy result but sets the bit regardless. Source: [OM-Emu study of Caduceus OM-3](../sources/emu.caduceus-om3.md).
